question: Who among the following Hindustani classical musicians was NOT associated with ‘Maihar Gharana’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ustad Bismillah Khan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **He was a legendary shehnai player** and is not associated with the Maihar Gharana.
 
• He was **more closely linked with the tradition of shehnai playing** and has his own distinct musical lineage.
 
• He belonged to the **Benares Gharana**, 
 
• His musical roots were in the traditional folk and classical music of Benares (Varanasi), and his work was central to the Ganga-Jamuni tehzeeb (syncretic culture) of that region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Ali Akbar Khan**:

 
 
• He was a noted sarod player and a key figure of the Maihar Gharana, contributing significantly to its development and popularity.
 
 
 
• **Pt Ravi Shankar**:
 
 
• He was also associated with the Maihar Gharana, primarily known for his innovative sitar playing and efforts to popularize Indian classical music worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Annapurna Devi**:
 
 
• She was a prominent musician associated with the Maihar Gharana, known for her mastery of the surbahar.
